meta.title: Features — DencPass
meta.description: Everything you need to protect your access: encrypted vault, secure sharing, zero-knowledge architecture, and Enterprise features.

hero.title: Everything you need to protect your access
hero.subtitle: From everyday password management to enterprise deployment with SIEM and Active Directory — without ever cutting corners on security, or forgetting Africa.

vault.title: Encrypted vault
vault.desc: Passwords, credentials and secure notes, with a change history per entry.

generator.title: Generator up to 128 char.
generator.desc: Configurable rules: length, symbols, digits. Or a memorable passphrase.

extensions.title: Browser extensions
extensions.desc: Automatic autofill and capture of credentials in Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

secrets.title: Secrets & certificates
secrets.desc: Store API keys, certificates and secure notes alongside your passwords.

import.title: Import in 2 minutes
import.desc: CSV import from Chrome, Bitwarden, LastPass, KeePass and KeePassXC.

score.title: Security score
score.desc: Detects weak, reused or compromised passwords via HIBP.

links.title: Temporary links
links.desc: Link-based sharing with view limits, expiration and revocation at any time.

teams.title: Teams & groups
teams.desc: Centralized access with roles and permissions per organization.

notifications.title: Access notifications
notifications.desc: Get notified every time a shared secret is viewed or changed.

aes.title: AES-256-GCM per entry
aes.desc: Every item encrypted individually with HMAC integrity control, before storage.

zeroKnowledge.title: Zero knowledge
zeroKnowledge.desc: Our servers cannot read your data. Even with physical access.

totp.title: 2FA TOTP
totp.desc: Compatible with Google Authenticator and Authy. The TOTP secret itself is encrypted at rest.

why.title: Where we actually stand out
why.subtitle: We don't claim to beat the giants at everything. Here's precisely where DencPass makes a difference for West Africa.

advFcfa.title: Pay in FCFA
advFcfa.desc: Pay directly in CFA francs via Wave or Orange Money. No currency conversion, no international card, no hidden fees.

advPassphrase.title: African passphrase
advPassphrase.desc: Memorable passphrases drawn from a wordlist spanning several African languages. Strong and easy to recall.
points: As strong as a random password

advHosting.title: Local hosting & support
advHosting.desc: Infrastructure and support built for French-speaking West Africa. Local compliance and a French interface.

why.parityTitle: Parity with the serious password managers
why.roadmapSubtitle: We'd rather be honest about what isn't there yet.

enterprise.title: Features for your teams
enterprise.desc: Purple marks the Organizations universe: access governance, integrations and On-Premise deployment for your IT teams.

cta.title: Ready to secure your access?
cta.subtitle: Free, no credit card required. Encrypted vault ready in 2 minutes.
